paper_title: Center-vortex semiclassics with non-minimal 't Hooft fluxes on $\mathbb R^2\times T^2$ and center stabilization at large $N$ (Hayashi, 2026, JHEP)
deeper_reasoning_4:
\textbf{Claim.}
At finite $N$ and $\theta=0$, the dilute center-vortex gas confines exactly the nontrivial $N$-ality sectors: the string tension vanishes if and only if the representation has trivial $N$-ality.

\textbf{Premises.}
\begin{align*}
\text{(P1)}\quad &N\ge2,\quad pq\equiv1\pmod N,\quad r:=|R|\in\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z.\\
\text{(P2)}\quad &a:=K e^{-8\pi^2/(Ng^2)}>0.\\
\text{(P3)}\quad &T_R(\theta)=2a\left[
\cos\left(\frac{\theta}{N}\right)
-\cos\left(\frac{\theta+2\pi qr}{N}\right)
\right].\\
\text{(P4)}\quad &1-\cos(2x)=2\sin^2x.\\
\text{(P5)}\quad &pq\equiv1\pmod N\Longrightarrow \gcd(q,N)=1.\\
\text{(P6)}\quad &\sin^2(\pi x)=0\Longleftrightarrow x\in\mathbb Z.
\end{align*}

\textbf{Derivation.}
Set $\theta=0$:
\begin{align}
T_R(0)
&=2a\left[1-\cos\left(\frac{2\pi qr}{N}\right)\right]
&&\text{by (P3)}\\
&=4a\sin^2\left(\frac{\pi qr}{N}\right)
&&\text{by (P4)}.
\end{align}
Since $a>0$,
\begin{align}
T_R(0)=0
&\Longleftrightarrow
\sin^2\left(\frac{\pi qr}{N}\right)=0\\
&\Longleftrightarrow
\frac{qr}{N}\in\mathbb Z
&&\text{by (P6)}\\
&\Longleftrightarrow
qr\equiv0\pmod N\\
&\Longleftrightarrow
r\equiv0\pmod N
&&\text{by }\gcd(q,N)=1.
\end{align}
Therefore every nonzero $N$-ality class has strictly positive tension, while screening occurs exactly for trivial $N$-ality.

\textbf{Final Result.}
\[
\boxed{
T_R(0)=4K e^{-8\pi^2/(Ng^2)}
\sin^2\left(\frac{\pi q|R|}{N}\right),
\qquad
T_R(0)=0\Longleftrightarrow |R|\equiv0\pmod N
}
\]
\hfill$\blacksquare$

deeper_reasoning_8.title: Fixed-charge irrational-limit criterion plus continued-fraction finite-window filter
deeper_reasoning_8.goal_alignment: Makes the continued-fraction analysis explicitly serve the G3 fixed-m residue criterion for both p_N and q_N, while retaining the Fibonacci finite-window advantage.
deeper_reasoning_8.scientific_payoff: Separates the exact pointwise large-N stability requirement from the practical finite-window problem of accidental small low-charge tensions.
deeper_reasoning_8.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Combines irrational-limit residue control, finite-window lower bounds, and continued-fraction suppression bounds into one hierarchy of diagnostics.
deeper_reasoning_8.formal_sharpness: High: fixed-m conclusions are proved from irrational limits; continued-fraction conclusions are stated as finite-window diagnostics, not as full optimality claims.

known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: Latex compilation depends only on article, amsmath, and amssymb; all generated entries were checked with this minimal preamble.
The anomaly bridge depends on cochain sign conventions; the reduced cup-square identity is stated explicitly and used consistently with the target response.
The large-N Fibonacci and irrational-limit conclusions are pointwise in fixed charges; charges growing with N are discussed only through the finite-window continued-fraction diagnostic.
The file does not claim the conjectural generic-L3,L4 vortex extension or full nonperturbative adiabatic continuity to R^4.
